notes.note: Fix round 4 of the delivery-state change: another window's queue-change notice only re-projects (it no longer starts a flush, and a held copy listed from another window no longer counts as a waiting row); public outbox rows carry sendUnderWay only while the claiming renderer's Web Lock is held, so the list reads Sending only then and the bubble agrees; Discard… stays mounted and the shared confirmation takes and returns focus; the composer's confirmation opens as its own popover; the phone sheet's inline actions are a group of buttons; the accepted outbox note reads in sentence case and outbox text wraps and clamps to two lines. Added the paragraph on the cross-window channel (refresh only, never a send, and why) and on Sending: only while the claiming window holds its renderer lock, otherwise 'No answer yet' with Check, re-read every few seconds while a send is under way elsewhere. Checked against useOutboundQueueFlush.ts, outboundQueue.ts publicTurns, OutboundQueuedMessages.tsx and the outbox e2e in mobile-chat-composer.spec.ts.
